[[C.D. Marathón|Marathón]] and [[Club Deportivo Olimpia|Olimpia]] claimed the Apertura and Clausura championships, respectively. ==Club information== Ten teams will participate in the 2009–10 season. Nine teams from last season remain for this season. [[C.D. Real Juventud|Real Juventud]] were relegated at the end of the [[Liga Nacional de Fútbol de Honduras 2008-09 Clausura|2008–09 season]]. They would have been replaced by [[Liga Nacional de Ascenso de Honduras]] promotion play-off winners [[Atlético Gualala]]. However, both teams decided to merge under the name of Real Juventud prior to the season.{{Citation needed|date=November 2009}} {| class="wikitable sortable" |- ! Club ! Two-legged ties in this stage were settled by [[Three points for a win|points]]: three for a win, one for a draw, and zero for a loss. Ties in points in the semifinals were settled first by goal difference, followed by the Classification Stage standings. A tie in points in the Finals would be settled by goal difference first, followed by two 15-minute extra-time periods, then a penalty shootout if necessary. ====Semifinals==== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |section=Apertura semifinal A |title=Semifinal A |res_col_header=QR |team1=MAR|name_MAR=[[C.D.
